 W.P.No.27
 Prayer:

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of
 for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, directing the 2nd respondent to 
 orders to issue Certificate for Food Inspector Training completed by
 petitioners prior to 05.08.2011 and consequently directing the 3rd
 respondent to appoint the petitioner to the post of Food Safety Offi
 par with their juniors on advent of Food Safety and Standard Act 200
 on 05.08.2011 with all consequential and other attendant benefits ba
 the Government Letter No.28698/M1/2014-2 dated 02.06.2015 and
 subsequent reminder in Letter No.32122/M1/2015-1 dated 05.11.2015
 issued by the 1st respondent dated 02.02.2015.

For Petitioners : Mr.G.Sankaran
 For Respondents : Mr.B.Vijay
 Additional Government Plea
 Order

The learned counsel for the petitioners made a submission that during the pendency of the writ petition, the competent authorities issued the Food Inspector Training Certificate to some of the writ petitioners and in respect of other writ petitioners, if they are otherwise eligible, their cases are also to be considered regarding appointment.
2.
The authorities are bound to follow the procedures as contemplated under the Acts and Rules, in the event of commencing https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis process of recruitment.
However, the appointment cannot be claimed as a matter of right and it is to be considered in accordance with the rules in force.
3. With these observations, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
